gap_interpretation.gap_rule: The preregistered rule is binary and leaves (5, 10) points undefined: a 7.25pp drop is neither >= 10pp (not SUPPORTED) nor within +-5pp (not REFUTED). Symmetrically, a gain steeper than -5pp (loss < -5) is also not classified by the ±5 refutation rule. This file therefore reports UNDEFINED for such drops and does not treat them as support.
gap_interpretation.h2_verbatim:
- **H2 (operating-point transfer).** The dev-fitted operating point, applied frozen to a
  disjoint-article held-out half *and* to a second corpus, loses ≥ 10 points of abstain precision at
  equal abstain recall relative to the dev figure.
  *Refuted if* the loss is within ±5 points (i.e. it transfers), or if the second corpus is unavailable
  (then H2 is reported as PARTIAL: within-corpus transfer only, and the second-corpus arm as NOT RUN).
gap_interpretation.note: D1.4: H2 gets no p-value. Holm family is H1 and H3 only. The second-corpus construct differs from SQuAD (2WikiMultihopQA: no article grouping, shorter passages, multi-hop questions), so the second-corpus arm is a direction test only (see transfer.json construct_note).
gap_interpretation.refuted_rule: loss is within +-5 points (i.e. it transfers)

note: Post-hoc application of the preregistered H2 criterion to the frozen and corrected second-corpus drops stored in transfer.json (D1.2 exploratory operating point, D4 corrected sensitivity analysis). The corrected confirmatory-band numbers are exploratory sensitivity only and cannot overturn the frozen confirmatory verdict.

confirmatory.criterion: SUPPORTED if drop >= 10pp; REFUTED if drop within +-5pp; else UNDEFINED

equal_recall_check.note: H2 requires equal abstain recall. equal_recall_check.holds reports whether this operating point meets it; the verdict is a frozen-threshold precision-drop verdict, not a recall-matched one unless holds is true.

confirmatory.recall_main_note: Per PREREGISTRATION.md section 6, abstain recall is the same mean as abstain precision (fraction refused on rung-3 negatives).
